AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

Recommendation: It is recommended the City Council accept the gifts as presented

5.
Special Event Application for the Lexus LaceUp Running Series Palos Verdes Marathon Scheduled for Saturday, November 16, 2019
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the request and fees charged to allow the Lexus LaceUp Running Series Palos Verdes to travel through Palos Verdes Estates on Saturday, November 16, 2019 from 7:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m.
Staff Report
6.
Receive and File the Annual Special Tax Accountability Report for Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2019
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the Annual Special Tax Accountability Report for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2019.
Staff Report
7.
Adoption of Resolution R19-32 For Budget Appropriation to Continue PM Traffic Control at Palos Verdes Drive West and Via Corta Intersection through June 30, 2019
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the contract extension with Black Knight Patrol, LLC to provide afternoon traffic control through the end of the fiscal year and approve Resolution R 19-32 appropriating an additional $43,750 to cover costs.
Staff Report
8.
Rejection of All Bids for FY 19/20 and FY 20/21 Catch Basin Cleaning Services City-Wide and Advertising of the Project with Revised Scope of Work
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council reject all bids for FY20/21 catch basin cleaning services and authorize staff to re-advertise the project with a revised scope of work.
Staff Report

Recommendation: Receive and File

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
ORDINANCE/PUBLIC HEARING(S)
10.
Introduction of Ordinance No. O19-740 Amending Chapter 18.28 (Outdoor Lighting) of Title 18 (Zoning Regulations) of the City's Municipal Code
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council open the public hearing, receive public input, close the public hearing, and introduce Ordinance No. O19-740 on first reading.
Staff Report
11.
Introduction of Ordinance No. O19-739 Amending Section 17.08.378 (Short-Term or Vacation Rental) of Chapter 17.08 (Definitions) of Title 17 (Zoning Procedures) and Title 18 (Zoning Regulations) of the City's Municipal Code Regulating Commercial Events
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council open the public hearing, receive public input, close the public hearing, and introduce Ordinance No. O19-739 on first reading.
Staff Report
OLD BUSINESS
12.
Los Angeles Consolidated Fire Protection District 2020 Ballot Measure
Recommendation: It is recommended that City Council provide staff with direction on whether to opt in or opt out the proposed Los Angeles Consolidated Fire Protection District 2020 Ballot Measure.
Staff Report
13.
Update and Discussion of the Activities of the Pension Ad Hoc Committee and the Police Operational Ad Hoc Committee
Recommendation: It is recommended the City Council receive updates from the Council Ad Hoc Committees, discuss the status of their work, and provide any direction Council deems appropriate.
Staff Report
NEW BUSINESS
14.
Consideration of the Palos Verdes Golf Club 2020 Proposed Operating and Capital Budgets, 2019 Projected Fiscal Results, and Direction in Regard the Updated Language and Amendments Proposed to Current Concession Agreement
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the 2020 operating and capital budgets of the Palos Verdes Golf Club and proposed changes in dues and fees and provide direction in reference to the updated Concession Agreement language and amendments proposed to the current Club Improvement Fund (CIF) member contributions, referral credit and preferences for the clubhouse.
Staff Report
15.
Consideration of the Withdrawal of Claim for the Difference in Back Rent from the PV Homes Association due to the City of Palos Verdes Estates and Discussion of the Current Lease Agreement
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council provide direction as to the withdrawal of this claim for the difference in back rent and further discussion and analysis of the original lease agreement.
Staff Report
16.
Discussion on Ban of Usage & Sales of Electronic Cigarettes and Vaporizers
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council provide direction to staff.
Staff Report
STAFF REPORTS
i.
City Manager's Report
MAYOR, CITY COUNCILMEMBERS AND AD HOC COMMITTEE REPORTS
This portion of the agenda is reserved for the Mayor and Councilmembers to provide comments, report on community activities and ad hoc committees, and propose topics to be calendared on a future Council agenda.
ADJOURNMENT TO TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 19, 2019, AT 6:30 P.M. IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS FOR THE PURPOSE OF A REGULAR MEETING.
ii.
This City Council meeting can be viewed via live-stream or on demand thereafter on the City Website at www.pvestates.org

Karina Bañales on behalf of Lauren Pettit, City Clerk
